<solution_file path="src/solution.py">
import pandas as pd

# Read the input files
metadata_tables = pd.read_csv('inputs/eurostat/metadata_tables.csv')
indicator_descriptions = pd.read_csv('inputs/eurostat/indicator_descriptions.csv')

# Filter the metadata tables to get the relevant themes
mobility_theme = metadata_tables[metadata_tables['theme'] == 'mobility']
population_density_theme = metadata_tables[metadata_tables['theme'] == 'population_density']
environment_theme = metadata_tables[metadata_tables['theme'] == 'environment']
living_conditions_theme = metadata_tables[metadata_tables['theme'] == 'living_conditions']

# Filter the indicator descriptions to get the relevant indicators
mobility_indicators = indicator_descriptions[indicator_descriptions['theme'] == 'mobility']
population_density_indicators = indicator_descriptions[indicator_descriptions['theme'] == 'population_density']
environment_indicators = indicator_descriptions[indicator_descriptions['theme'] == 'environment']
living_conditions_indicators = indicator_descriptions[indicator_descriptions['theme'] == 'living_conditions']

# Select 10-15 indicators that cover the relevant themes
selected_indicators = pd.concat([mobility_indicators.head(5),
                                population_density_indicators.head(3),
                                environment_indicators.head(3),
                                living_conditions_indicators.head(5)])

# Fill the justification column with a short reason
selected_indicators['justification'] = ['Relevant for urban mobility' for _ in range(5)] + \
                                      ['Relevant for population density' for _ in range(3)] + \
                                      ['Relevant for environmental sustainability' for _ in range(3)] + \
                                      ['Relevant for living conditions' for _ in range(5)]

# Write the selected indicators to the output file
selected_indicators[['indicator_id', 'indicator_name', 'theme', 'justification', 'expected_direction']].to_csv('outputs/t01_selected_indicators.csv', index=False)
</solution_file>
